detail.longDescription: Until Claude Code 2.1.314 (Oct 30), claude -p exited 0 with no output when startup failed. In CI that is a green check on a job where the agent never ran. Now it prints the error and exits 1. Still worth having agent steps fail on empty output, not just on exit code. https:// github.com/anthropics/claude-c ode/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md If you'd rather watch a headless agent run live than read its log afterward, we built https:// shell.online for that. # DevOps # AIAgents # ClaudeCode
